{{Quote|Arkanian Dawn. Good name for a ship, that.|Corwin Shelvay to Dawn|<ref name="GG9" />}}
'''''Arkanian Dawn''''' was one of the most infamous [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Throughout the Rim, the ''Dawn'' held the reputation as a [[Death/Legends|death]] ship&mdash;though, in reality, its [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dawn Arkanian]], used the ''Dawn'' to rescue thousands of slaves, taking them to Alliance safe [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] where they were freed.
